notes.title: Update 1.1 - Color Blind Options
notes.notes: Enhanced Accessibility for Color Blindness: Protanopia, Protanomaly, Deuteranopia, Deuteranomaly, Tritanopia, Tritanomaly, Achromatopsia, Achromatomaly

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
Hotfix update 1.0.4.1
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue that causes the game to not spawn the Hextones when is the first time playing the game.
Thanks to Uncle Fisto user.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
We've just updated some UI elements to enhance the readability for small resolutions. Things like button fonts and the tier challenge UI.

Also, we've updated our leaderboards lists to be able to show oriental characters for the players' names. Now we have:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Hong Kong Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Mac version
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - controller support
